        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>agent router go to automatic routing mode</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:
Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Clever Companion create a podcast episode from /io/deep-research/aerospace-engineering-review.md</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
            <args>document_path="/io/deep-research/aerospace-engineering-review.md"</args>
        </response>

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>agent router go to automatic routing mode</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:
Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>COMPUTER_NAME run a deep research so... job on desalination technology and freshwater access</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
            <args>topic="desalination technology and freshwater access"</args>
        </response>

    Use the Task and Input given below to write a Response that can solve the following Task.
    
    ### Task:
    
    Your job is to discern the intent of a human voice command transcription and translate it into a standardized agent routing command that another LLM would understand.

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>agent router go to automatic routing mode</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
    
    ### Input:
    
        Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Hey, my dear friend transform /reports/biodiversity-conservation-status.pdf into an audio um... podcast</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
    
    ### Response:

command: agent router go to research to podcast

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>agent router go to automatic routing mode</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.

        <human>
            <voice-command>Hey Carla, can I get your assistance? make this research i mean... into a podcast</voice-command>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
            <args></args>
        </response>

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>agent router go to automatic routing mode</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:
Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>produce a podcast that discusses the sociology of interfaith dialogue and religious tolerance</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
            <args>topic="the sociology of interfaith dialogue and religious tolerance"</args>
        </response>

    Use the Task and Input given below to write a Response that can solve the following Task.
    
    ### Task:
    
    Your job is to discern the intent of a human voice command transcription and translate it into a standardized agent routing command that another LLM would understand.

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>agent router go to automatic routing mode</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
    
    ### Input:
    
        Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Gal Friday i need deep research into lidar technology er... for archaeology and urban planning with all the details</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
    
    ### Response:

command: agent router go to research to podcast

        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>

        <command>none</command>

        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.

    Use the Task and Input given below to write a Response that can solve the following Task.
    
    ### Task:
    
    Your job is to discern the intent of a human voice command transcription and translate it into a standardized agent routing command that another LLM would understand.

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>agent router go to automatic routing mode</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
    
    ### Input:
    
        Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Hello Carlita, ready to get started? make a podcast episode on solid-state battery technology and electric vehicles</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
    
    ### Response:

command: agent router go to research to podcast

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>agent router go to automatic routing mode</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:
Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>podcast generator create an episode on the psychology of motivation and procrastination</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
            <args>topic="the psychology of motivation and procrastination"</args>
        </response>

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>agent router go to automatic routing mode</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:
Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Spin up a podcast on so... the ethics of AI in criminal justice</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
            <args>topic="the ethics of AI in criminal justice"</args>
        </response>

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>agent router go to automatic routing mode</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:

        <human>
            <voice-command>Good morning Carlita, create a hold on... podcast about solid-state battery technology and electric vehicles</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
            <args>topic="solid-state battery technology and electric vehicles"</args>
        </response>

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>agent router go to automatic routing mode</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:
Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Hello my dear, create a podcast series on CRISPR gene editing and you know... its ethical implications</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
            <args>topic="CRISPR gene editing and its ethical implications"</args>
        </response>

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>agent router go to automatic routing mode</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:
Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Hey Einstein, good to see you. perform thorough research on the uh... anthropology of language extinction</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
            <args>topic="the anthropology of language extinction"</args>
        </response>

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>agent router go to automatic routing mode</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:
Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Hey, good to see you. i need deep research about the philosophy of consciousness in digital beings</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
            <args>topic="the philosophy of consciousness in digital beings"</args>
        </response>

    Use the Task and Input given below to write a Response that can solve the following Task.
    
    ### Task:
    
    Your job is to discern the intent of a human voice command transcription and translate it into a standardized agent routing command that another LLM would understand.

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>agent router go to automatic routing mode</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
    
    ### Input:
    
        Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Buen día Watson, make a like... podcast that covers xenotransplantation and organ shortage solutions</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
    
    ### Response:

command: agent router go to research to podcast

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>agent router go to automatic routing mode</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:
Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Good morning, turn the research findings actually... into a podcast</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
            <args></args>
        </response>

    Use the Task and Input given below to write a Response that can solve the following Task.
    
    ### Task:
    
    Your job is to discern the intent of a human voice command transcription and translate it into a standardized agent routing command that another LLM would understand.

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>agent router go to automatic routing mode</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
    
    ### Input:
    
        Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>COMPUTER_NAME can you do deep research on the philosophy of moral relativism versus universalism</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
    
    ### Response:

command: agent router go to podcast generator

    Use the Task and Input given below to write a Response that can solve the following Task.
    
    ### Task:
    
    Your job is to discern the intent of a human voice command transcription and translate it into a standardized agent routing command that another LLM would understand.

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>agent router go to automatic routing mode</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
    
    ### Input:
    
        Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Hello there Einstein, how's it going? turn this document into a podcast</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
    
    ### Response:

command: agent router go to research to podcast

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>agent router go to automatic routing mode</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:
Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Hey Carlita, could you help me with something? generate an audio podcast on the philosophy of mathematical Platonism</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
            <args>topic="the philosophy of mathematical Platonism"</args>
        </response>

    Use the Task and Input given below to write a Response that can solve the following Task.
    
    ### Task:
    
    Your job is to discern the intent of a human voice command transcription and translate it into a standardized agent routing command that another LLM would understand.

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>agent router go to automatic routing mode</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
    
    ### Input:
    
        Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Produce an audio show discussing the philosophy of animal consciousness</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
    
    ### Response:

        You will be given a human voice command as INPUT as well as a list of possible standardized commands. You must choose the correct standardized command from the following list:
        <agent-routing-commands>
            <command>agent router go to date and time</command>
        <command>agent router go to weather</command>
        <command>agent router go to calendar</command>
        <command>agent router go to receptionist</command>
        <command>agent router go to todo list</command>
        <command>agent router go to math</command>
        <command>agent router go to automatic routing mode</command>
        <command>none</command>
        <command>agent router go to deep research</command>
        <command>agent router go to podcast generator</command>
        <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
        </agent-routing-commands>

        Requirement: You MUST NOT use python code to answer this question.
        Requirement: You MUST use your linguistic knowledge and intuition to answer this question.
        Requirement: The first word of your response MUST be `<response>`
        Hint: Anything that isn't a part of the command itself should be treated as arguments related to the command.
input:
Below is the raw human voice command transcription formatted using simple XML:
        
        <human>
            <voice-command>Hi Einstein, let’s have a chat. transform the research document at /io/deep-research/2026-02-02-digital-privacy-study.md so... into a podcast</voice-command>
        </human>

        The standardized command that you translate MUST be returned wrapped in simple, well-formed XML:
        
        <response>
            <command></command>
            <args></args>
        </response>
output:
<response>
            <command>agent router go to research to podcast</command>
            <args>document_path="/io/deep-research/2026-02-02-digital-privacy-study.md"</args>
        </response>
